title: I Will Trust and Not Be Afraid
traveler_why: Tonight is about a heart that jumps at the thunder and chooses to trust anyway, and Beau the Brave is the Traveler who is honestly startled first and brave second — he takes the deep breath, remembers Isaiah’s song, and hums until the storm has gone past.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because he trusts Heavenly Father instead of being afraid. In Beau’s world today: there was a big thunderstorm, and the loud booms made Beau’s heart jump. But he took a deep breath and remembered Isaiah’s song. “Heavenly Father is with me — I will trust and not be afraid,” he whispered, and he even hummed a little tune until the storm passed. Just like Isaiah sang about trusting and not fearing, Beau turned his scared feeling into a brave, trusting one.
